tables.description: One row per contact offered to the contact center (phone, chat, email, callback, secure message), answered or abandoned.

columns.description: Primary key, roughly in time order.
Customer (customer); null = anonymous / unauthenticated (~8% of phone and chat).
Queue the contact was routed to (dim_queue).
Agent who handled it (dim_agent); null when abandoned.
Set when the contact was driven by a product launch.
15-minute interval the contact was offered in (dim_time_interval).
Entered the queue (phone/chat), email/secure message received, or callback requested.
Agent connected (phone/chat/callback) or agent opened the email/message. Null if abandoned.
Customer hung up / left chat before an agent answered.
Customer disconnected (or email reply sent). Wrap-up starts here.
Seconds waiting in queue: answered_ts - offered_ts (or abandoned_ts - offered_ts).
Talk / chat / email work seconds (excludes hold).
Seconds the customer was on hold.
Number of times the customer was put on hold.
True if an agent answered/handled the contact.
True if the customer gave up before an agent answered (phone and chat only).
Abandoned within 5 seconds; excluded from service level by convention.
Answered within the queue's service level threshold.
True if transferred to another agent or queue.
Resolved on first contact (agent disposition). Null for abandoned.
Same customer contacted again (any channel) within 7 days after this contact.
True if escalated to a supervisor or specialist team.
Chats the agent had open when this chat was answered (including this one).
Email / secure message only: number of replies sent; null for other channels.

columns.description: Available (logged in, ready or on a contact), Break, Lunch, Training, Coaching, Meeting or Unavailable (unplanned aux).

tables.description: 15-minute x queue: forecast vs actual volume, handle time, staffing and service level. Aggregated from cc.contact and cc.agent_schedule.

columns.description: Start of the 15-minute interval (part of primary key).
Forecast = average offered in the same interval on the previous 4 same weekdays (open days).
Contacts answered within the queue's service level threshold.
Abandoned within 5 seconds (excluded from service level).
Forecast average handle time (previous 4 same weekdays).
Actual average handle time of answered contacts.
Average speed of answer: mean queue wait of answered contacts.
Planned Open Shift FTE for the channel group, allocated to queues by forecast share.
forecast x forecast AHT / (900 s x 85% occupancy); chat divided by 2.5 concurrent chats.

True for Open Shift (time planned for handling contacts).

Mass, Mass Affluent, Private or Small Business.

tables.description: Customer complaints (from contacts, surveys, and outside the contact center).

columns.description: Contact that raised it (contact); null if raised outside the contact center.
Complaint resolved; null while still open.
Days from opened to closed; null while open.
Where it was raised: a contact channel, Survey Follow-up, Branch, Web Form, Social Media or Regulator Referral.
Complaint category, e.g. Fees & Charges, Digital Banking, Service Quality.
True if reportable to a regulator.
Launch the complaint relates to (product_launch); null if none.

tables.description: Agent x scheduled workday summary: adherence, conformance, occupancy, shrinkage, productivity, quality.

columns.description: Work date (dim_date; part of primary key).
Unplanned absence (scheduled but did not log in).
Minutes logged in, in any state.
Minutes where the actual state matched the scheduled activity.
Minutes where actual state matched the scheduled activity / scheduled minutes x 100. Null on PTO/absent days.
Logged-in minutes / scheduled minutes x 100 (can exceed 100).
Minutes between scheduled start and first login (0 if on time or early).
Minutes between last logout and scheduled end (0 if on time or late).
Break and lunch minutes taken beyond the scheduled length.
Minutes in the Unavailable state (not on the schedule).
Total handle minutes of contacts answered that day.
Handle time / Available time x 100 (chat divided by allowed concurrent chats).
Scheduled minutes lost to unplanned absence.
Average queue wait of the contacts the agent answered.
First contact resolution % of contacts answered.
Quality evaluation score 50-100 (sampled ~1 day in 5); null when not evaluated.
